jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Contract Onboarding
jobs.description: Are you excited to build with GenAI at the center of how you work? The AWS Contract Onboarding team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to build automated audit and control systems that protect billions of dollars in AWS revenue - embracing Prompt Driven Development and LLM-powered tooling to solve problems faster and turn manual, error-prone contract operations into reliable automation. Key job responsibilities As a Software Development Engineer, you will own all aspects of the software development lifecycle - design, architecture, implementation, testing, and operations. Your team builds the audit, controls-validation, and workflow-automation systems that ensure human-managed private pricing agreements are accurate, compliant, and efficient at global scale. GenAI is core to how we build: you'll practice Prompt Driven Development to accelerate design, implementation, and problem-solving. In this role, you will… • Design and build automated audit capabilities that detect discrepancies across contract data, discounts, and billing outcomes. • Build controls-validation systems that enforce correctness and compliance across the contract lifecycle. • Automate manual operational flows to reduce risk, toil, and processing time. • Own and operate distributed systems processing confidential contractual and financial data under demanding SLAs. • Build event-driven architectures using AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, DynamoDB). • Apply GenAI and Prompt Driven Development to accelerate how you design, build, and ship software • Collaborate with Product Managers and partner engineering teams to define scope and technical direction. • Write high-quality, testable code in multiple languages including Java, Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript. • Build highly available, secure systems at Amazon scale. • Mentor and support the growth of other developers. A day in the life On a typical day, you might use Prompt Driven Development to rapidly prototype a new automated audit for a particular contract type, generate an LLM-assisted validation guardrail, debug a distributed event-processing issue, or deep-dive into audit results to root-cause a discrepancy before it impacts a customer. GenAI is part of your everyday toolkit - you'll lean on it to move faster and raise the bar on what you ship. We move fast, own what we build, and measure our impact in errors prevented and hours automated. About the team Our team builds software that ensures accuracy, efficiency, and risk mitigation across the human-managed private pricing contract lifecycle. We enable comprehensive automated audits, controls-validation systems, and operational-flow automation that safeguard how AWS's largest customers are billed. We're an early and enthusiastic adopter of GenAI to reimagine what was previously manual, error-prone contract operations as fast, reliable, automated systems. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 3+ years of server-side development experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Platform & Analytics - ART19
jobs.description: --About ART19-- ART19 is a leading audio platform, providing best-in-class tools for on-demand hosting, distribution, ad serving, and audience measurement. At the intersection of publishers and advertisers, the company powers hundreds of millions of podcast downloads every month for the industry’s largest shows. ART19 enables publishers to manage all content and ad operations in one place, offering best-in-class targeting capabilities, seamless integration with listening platforms, and a flexible infrastructure to continuously enhance revenue opportunities for its customers. ART19 equips advertisers with services to reach audiences through smart targeting and custom ad creative capabilities. In addition to offering best-in-class podcast hosting and we also power ad products that enable a growing targeted ad marketplace across a pool of more than 1,000 podcasts that includes shows such as “How I Built This", "Morbid," and "Smartless", from major podcast networks like Wondery, CBS News, and NBC Universal. Key job responsibilities Software Development Engineers on the ART19 team are end-to-end owners. They use technology to solve complex problems across the podcast ecosystem, collaborating with team members in and across teams. They have the responsibility to improve and build new tools, services, and applications. Taking a business problem from conception and designing, developing and deploying software solutions while holding a high bar for code quality and their craft, is at the heart of how they make impact. They have a responsibility to deliver on schedule using current software engineering best practices. Communication is an integral part of this role, and there is an expectation that they will engage with stakeholders on planning and communication of project deliverables. They may also be part of an on-call rotation within their team and in the event of problems, are able to troubleshoot, research the root cause, thoroughly resolve defects whilst maintaining ongoing communication with stakeholders and customers. Ads domain knowledge will be key in this role. --Work/Life Harmony-- Our team also puts a high value on work-life harmony. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. --Mentorship & Career Growth-- Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and detailed and constructive code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. A day in the life We prioritize distraction-free productivity so a day in the life of an ART19 engineer is focused and hands-on. You will work within a team of cross-functional engineers, product managers and designers, constructing the end-to-end features to enhance best-in-class tools for podcast creators. You will find yourself writing and reviewing code, architecting cool new things, and solving technical challenges. About the team We believe in delivering the highest quality tools to empower and delight our customers. We act swiftly - recognizing our customers’ changing needs - and regularly introduce innovative features. Each member of the team is an owner and we give them the agency and voice necessary to thrive. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Elemental MediaTailor
jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Are you excited about shaping the future of video streaming and advertising technology? AWS Elemental MediaTailor is a cloud-based service that lets content providers deliver personalized, broadcast-quality ad experiences at massive scale. Using server-side ad insertion (SSAI), we seamlessly stitch targeted ads into live and on-demand video streams — powering some of the world's largest streaming platforms. Our team tackles complex challenges in manifest manipulation, dynamic ad decisioning, and real-time reporting, helping customers maximize ad revenue without compromising the viewer experience. As video consumption continues its shift to streaming, you'll be at the forefront of bridging traditional TV advertising with the digital future. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement features for our video streaming and ad insertion service that scale to millions of concurrent viewers - Write high-quality, well-tested code that meets our operational excellence standards - Participate in the on-call rotation to support our 24/7 video streaming services - Collaborate with senior engineers to improve system architecture and operational efficiency - Identify and resolve complex technical issues across distributed systems - Participate in code reviews and help maintain high code quality standards - Document technical decisions and share knowledge with the team A day in the life At AWS Elemental MediaTailor, no two days are the same. Your morning might start with deep diving into a tricky ad insertion bug escalated to the team. Before lunch, you join standup to sync with colleagues across time zones. In the afternoon, you could be drafting a design document for dynamic ad replacement in live sports events, weighing architectural trade-offs. Later, you might help a teammate debug a device-specific ad insertion failure by analyzing internal logs. Throughout the day, you'll work with native AWS components, collaborate across teams, and make decisions that directly impact the streaming experience of millions of viewers worldwide. About the team The AWS Elemental MediaTailor team builds and operates the cloud service that powers personalized ad experiences for some of the world's largest streaming platforms. We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about video technology, distributed systems, and delivering seamless viewing experiences at massive scale. Our team values operational excellence, customer obsession, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive environment where every voice matters and bold ideas are encouraged. Whether you're debugging a live-stream issue or designing the next generation of ad insertion technology, you'll be surrounded by teammates who are invested in your growth and success. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - Experience in Digital advertising and expertise in related ad specifications, file formats and technologies - Hands-on experience with video streaming technologies like DASH and HLS - Experience building and operating SGAI and SSAI solutions for millions of concurrent viewers Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Personalization, Amazon Personalization
jobs.description: What if Amazon knew not just what you like, but what your partner is into, what to get your mom for her birthday, and what toy your dog will actually play with? We're working on that. You'll work at the intersection of large language models and real-time personalization, solving problems that are genuinely open and at a scale very few teams get to work on. We have the foundation shipped; now we need to go deeper. Key job responsibilities As a Software Development Engineer, you will build systems at the intersection of AI, real-time data, and customer personalization at Amazon scale. 1. Design and build services that use large language models to extract structured knowledge from natural language and serve it in real time across Amazon's biggest customer surfaces. 2. Build reliable infrastructure around AI systems that are inherently unpredictable, handling hallucinations, latency spikes, and model drift so customers always get a great experience. 3. Develop pipelines that process millions of customer signals daily into durable, retrievable, personalized data stores. 4. Create monitoring and evaluation frameworks for AI outputs where traditional testing doesn't apply, including automated quality measurement and human-in-the-loop validation. 5. Collaborate with Applied Scientists to take models from research to production, owning the path from prototype to scaled deployment. 6. Build customer-facing feedback loops where real-world corrections compound system quality over time. 7. Ship fast and incrementally, owning the full lifecycle from infrastructure to alarms to on-call. About the team We are Amazon's Customer360 Personalization team. We build the system that understands every important person in a customer's life and personalizes Amazon for each of them individually. We identify what customers care about from signals across all of Amazon and curate it into personalized experiences for every person in their life. Our engineers are hyper-productive, leveraging AI daily to accelerate their own work while building systems that overcome AI's limitations at scale. The team values builders who take full ownership of what they ship, move fast, ask for help early, and care more about customer outcomes than technical elegance. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases) - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Engineer UX
jobs.description: Overview Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. HM Team Description: We are the Entra Admin Management UX team part of IAM organization, to empower every Entra customer to drive organizational compliance and security through a high-quality, secure, and intelligent admin center. The team builds and maintains the Entra Admin Center – a single interface for managing Identities and access. It supports cloud environment and aims to deliver intuitive, consistent, and secure unified Admin experience; leads frontend engineering for Entra, setting standards for shared UX libraries. The team is also driving a transformative shift toward AI-first experience across agents, workflows and admin interfaces to provide unified Entra AI UX platform and shared infrastructure. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond Responsibilities Builds the Entra Admin Center, the primary platform for identity and access administration. Creates secure, intuitive, and AI-powered admin experiences for enterprise customers. Leads frontend engineering standards and shared UX libraries across Entra. Builds and operates scalable, secure, and accessible cloud services and user experiences. Partners with engineers, architects, designers, and product managers to deliver customer value. Develops reusable components and AI-first capabilities to improve quality and speed. Collaborates across Microsoft teams to deliver new features and platform improvements.
